channel.title: Spatial Omics Radar — email digest
channel.description: New technologies, tools, AI models and benchmarks across spatial omics

item.title: Weekly update · 54 new entries
item.description:
54 new entries this week, spanning transcriptomics, proteomics, metabolomics, multi-omics, and 3 more.

MechanoMaST
Computationally co-registers AFM nanoindentation stiffness maps with spatial transcriptomics from adjacent tissue sections.

SPOT (Spatial Omics Toolkit)
Open-source pipeline applying single-cell/spatial-transcriptomics statistical methods to mass spectrometry imaging data.

Poly Pipeline
Universal workflow converting formats and clustering/co-expression analysis for spatial transcriptomics in polyploid and diploid organisms.

Ageas
Time-agnostic transfer learning framework inferring cell fate bias from single-cell and spatial multi-omics snapshots.

LRSPAT
Low-rank framework approximating spatial statistics (Moran's I, Geary's C) for fast spatially variable gene detection.

SemanticST
Graph neural network with mini-batch training and multi-semantic fusion for spatial niche detection and sample integration.

SCR (Spatial Covariance Regression)
Bayesian factor-model framework estimating spatially-resolved gene co-expression networks to identify spatially co-expressed genes.

COAST
Aligns consecutive multi-omics tissue sections using only associated images, without shared molecular features.

jsPCA
Computes spatial covariance via joint PCA to identify spatial domains and variable genes across multi-slice/sample datasets.

Kintsugi
Deterministic tessellation partitions subcellular ST count matrices by UMI density to reveal nucleus-poor tissue compartments.

spatial NT-seq
Combines transgenesis-free metabolic RNA labeling with in situ chemical recoding to co-map new and pre-existing RNA spatially.

UniGeneX
Generative foundation model reconstructs a universal gene expression space integrating single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data.

SCIGMA
Deep learning framework with uncertainty-aware contrastive learning and graph networks for integrating spatial multiomics data.

FACTMx
Variational encoder-decoder framework jointly modeling structured multimodal patient data for interpretable latent representations.

Spatial-ATAC-Hi-C
Microfluidic platform for spatially resolved joint profiling of chromatin accessibility and 3D genome organization in tissue.

spatialMET
Open-source end-to-end framework for preprocessing, spatial domain detection and analysis of MSI data.

6-AQ/DHB matrix
Binary MALDI matrix enabling isomer-selective, high-sensitivity imaging of mono- and oligosaccharides in tissue.

MP-MSI (AFADESI)
High-throughput microplate mass spectrometry imaging workflow combining targeted quantitation and untargeted metabolomics.

Cold solvent washing AFADESI-MSI
Cold solvent washing step enhances lipid detection sensitivity in AFADESI mass spectrometry imaging of tissue.

hex-MASP
3D-printed hexagonal micro-well platform for whole-tissue spatial proteomic mapping via LC-MS.

mspix
Efficient file format and Python tools for storing and accessing high-pixel-count mass spectrometry images.

Spl-ISO-Seq2
Spatial long-read isoform sequencing at 500-nm/single-cell resolution with Spl-IsoQuant-2/Spl-IsoFind software.

AltraFlowSOM
Semi-supervised FlowSOM extension embedding expert annotations for IMC cell phenotyping and rare population detection.

Paired-surface spatial mechanomics
Co-registers tissue stiffness maps from nanoindentation with adjacent Visium HD spatial transcriptomics.

spoQC
Modular framework for multimodal quality control of imaging-based spatially resolved transcriptomics data.

stKAN
Deep learning framework combining Kolmogorov-Arnold networks, VAE and graph attention to detect spatial domains from expression and morphology.

GRAIL-Heart
Graph attention network predicting directional ligand-receptor interactions and causal signalling from spatial transcriptomics.

RETROFIT
Bayesian framework for reference-free deconvolution of cell-type mixtures in spatial transcriptomics, including near-single-cell resolution.

HisToSpatialCNV
Predicts spatial copy number variation patterns from H&E histopathology images using a multiscale GNN/attention model.

DREAMS
Mass spectrometry imaging platform that spatially maps DNA and RNA nucleic acid modifications simultaneously in tissue.

SACCELERATOR
Extensible framework standardizing data, method integration and metrics for evaluating spatially aware clustering methods via expert consensus.

SlotDeconv
Deconvolves spot-based spatial transcriptomics using slot-based prototype learning and spatial refinement.

SPIDER
Denoises spatial transcriptomics data using graph encoders guided by scRNA-seq-derived pseudo-ST supervision.

DESpace2
Framework detecting genes with differential spatial expression patterns between experimental conditions in spatial transcriptomics.

ARCADIA
Dual-autoencoder generative framework aligning archetypes to integrate scRNA-seq with spatial proteomics without paired cells.

TIMSImaging
Open-source workflow for processing and visualizing trapped ion mobility MALDI-MSI data.

SpaAlign
Two-stage contrastive and self-supervised clustering framework integrating spatial multi-omics and histological data.

DeepPathway
Predicts spatial pathway expression from H&E histology images using contrastive learning trained on ST data.

STcompare
Statistical framework testing spatial correlation and fold-change differences between structurally matched tissue samples.

st2traj
Deconvolution-informed trajectory inference framework using spot-state composition for multi-timepoint spatial transcriptomics.

DIME
Graph contrastive learning and optimal transport framework aligning and embedding spatial multiomics from unaligned serial sections.

MSI-VISUAL
Open-source framework with novel dimensionality-reduction visualizations for interactive MSI exploration.

PF-Map
Organic photocatalyst enabling probe-free dual-radical proximity labeling for spatial protein mapping in live cells.

Custom Probe-Based Spatial Transcriptomics Enables Microbiome Detection in FFPE Colorectal Cancer Tissue
Custom 16S rRNA probe design compatible with Visium CytAssist chemistry enabling bacterial detection in FFPE tissue.

Benchmarking cell type annotation in spatial transcriptomics: resolving cellular hierarchies, biological fidelity, and dynamic cell states
Benchmarks 20 cell-type annotation methods across four spatial transcriptomics technologies and six scenarios.

UELer
Jupyter-based interactive viewer linking multiplexed image views with quantitative spatial proteomics analysis.

G2T
Reconstructs 2D tissue coordinates from gene expression via a flow-matching transformer predicting cell distance matrices.

RECON
Infers regions of interest from H&E images and predicts single-cell molecular profiles across whole slides.

nf_xpatial
Nextflow pipeline for standardized QC, normalization, integration and clustering of 10x Xenium spatial transcriptomics data.

L-STAR
Uses a visual LLM to rank and combine existing spatial domain detection methods into a consensus result.

Flexify
Synthesis-ready fusion probes plus Flexify software add oncogenic fusion detection to 10x Flex/Visium assays.

A Scalable Cross-Modal Workflow for Linking In Vivo Neural Activity to Neuronal Cell Types via Spatial Gene Profiling
Cross-modal workflow linking in vivo two-photon calcium activity to neuronal cell types via EASI-FISH spatial profiling.

sclet
State-aware toolkit for analyzing single-cell and spatial transcriptomics data within SingleCellExperiment objects.

odon
Rust-based ultra-fast viewer for spatial proteomics data stored in OME-Zarr format.
